question: Which state was ranked first in the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) Awards 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer is option 1, Uttar Pradesh, which was ranked first in the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) Awards 2021. **
 
• ** PMAY-U is a flagship housing scheme launched by the Government of India in 2015 with the aim of providing affordable housing to the urban poor. The scheme targets the economically weaker sections (EWS), low-income groups (LIG), and middle-income groups (MIG) in urban areas.**
 
• The PMAY-U Awards are given to states, cities, and beneficiaries for their outstanding performance in implementing the scheme and achieving its objectives. The awards were announced on 25th June 2021 by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
 
• Uttar Pradesh was ranked first in the category of Best Performing State in the implementation of PMAY-U, with a score of 85.50 out of 100. The state was recognized for its efforts in completing the construction of houses within the stipulated time frame and ensuring quality and affordability of the houses.
 
• Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Haryana were also among the top-performing states in the PMAY-U Awards 2021. Kerala was ranked second, Tamil Nadu was ranked third, and Haryana was ranked fourth. These states were appreciated for their innovative approaches, use of technology, and community participation in the implementation of the schemeh.
